candidate_workaround: Run native commands before object construction, capture their exit codes in scalar variables, and build the summary only from those values.
failure_signature: PowerShell rejected a hashtable value expression that contained a native command and statement separator.
recurrence_guard: Never embed compound native-command statements inside PowerShell hashtable value expressions; evaluate and store them first.
rollback: Give the parser-failed wrapper zero staged-review credit and make no inference from it.
scope_boundary: Same-owner PowerShell wrapper recovery only; not shell correctness, repository certification, or independent reproduction.
title: Separate native commands from PowerShell summary objects
trigger_preconditions: a PowerShell summary includes a native-command result
the result needs an exit code
